svg.aria-label: Sketch after an NBC News photograph: the West Wing entrance of the White House, a flat-roofed portico on square columns with glass double doors, two ball-shaped topiary trees in square planters, a Marine guard drawn as a contour with no features, a long clipped boxwood hedge, a broadcast television camera on a tall tripod with cables hanging in the right foreground, a folding music stand on the drive, and the Eisenhower Executive Office Building with rows of tall windows and an American flag hung on its facade behind an iron fence.
